items.title: Poll tax riot
items.line: A march against the poll tax turned into a riot around Trafalgar Square on 31 March 1990. Police made 339 arrests and 113 people were injured.

items.title: Twin Peaks
items.line: David Lynch and Mark Frost's Twin Peaks premiered on ABC on 8 April 1990. Angelo Badalamenti scored it with Lynch, and the theme is an instrumental of Julee Cruise's 'Falling'.

items.title: Spike Island
items.line: The Stone Roses played Spike Island in Widnes on 27 May 1990 to about 30,000, some 2,000 of them gatecrashers.

items.title: Super Famicom
items.line: The Super Famicom went on sale in Japan on 21 November 1990 at ¥25,000 with Super Mario World and F-Zero. The first 300,000 sold out in hours.

items.title: Thatcher resigns
items.line: After Michael Heseltine's leadership challenge, Margaret Thatcher announced her resignation on 22 November 1990 and left Downing Street on 28 November after 11 years.
